agent_priors_used: Comparators at a correctness ceiling make a treatment advantage unobservable, so dynamic range must be engineered before, not after, an economics experiment (agent prior; SPIDER's own EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 bounded substrate-class negative is consistent with it but does not establish it as a general law).

Deterministic caching and replay of web interactions is a mature pattern that yields large speedups on cache hits but silent wrong-action failures when selectors or state drift (agent prior; the pre-2.0 P2-REPLAY-COST withdrawal, sha 9687ff787f2d74460bb7006826008852f5b4416b, is consistent with it but does not establish it as SPIDER evidence).

Procedural memory over-specializes and transfers poorly without explicit parameterization, preconditions and applicability guards (agent prior; no SPIDER packet has yet demonstrated cross-site transfer, so this motivates the guard/carrier design rather than being taken as shown).

Long local continuation on a single claim has diminishing marginal information and can crowd out higher-value problems even when each incremental step looks locally reasonable (agent prior used only to interpret the runtime/graph/physics tunnel flags, explicitly not as an order to pivot).

Supplying the task goal and schema in the system prompt can convert partial multi-step completions into full completions (agent prior; not SPIDER evidence, and Intel's bounded test is the only way to establish it in this factory).

I did not adopt the implicit suggestion to preempt Intel's endpoint mandate in favor of external baselines this cycle: the bounded prompt-underspecification test is the only credential-free path to B3 and both branches change a decision, so it is continued once, with the external-baseline program recorded as Intel's next objective.
